summary.what_it_is: Claude-Mem gives AI coding agents persistent memory across sessions. It runs a side agent that records what happens during a session, compresses the notes with AI, and injects relevant context when a new session starts. It works with Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Gemini, and other agents.
summary.why_trending: The project is currently shown as a GitHub Trending Repository of the Day, and the topic of long-term memory for AI agents is widely discussed right now.
summary.who_its_for: Developers who use AI coding assistants and want them to remember past work across sessions.
